verdict.rationale: A probe reports that an official Cloudflare MCP server is documented at the developer agent-setup page, so a first-party MCP connection path exists from the same vendor. Nothing in the pack shows that this server exposes Registrar domain search, registration or management tools. The only Registrar-specific programmatic surface is the REST API. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server covers Registrar operations, setup and authentication details, the tool list, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
